elements.title: Monthly Consumption of Coal for Electricity Generation in the United States from 2016 to 2022

details.chart type: line chart with shaded confidence interval
details.y-axis units: not explicitly stated but presumably tons or similar

values.Original Time Series: fluctuates mostly between 25,000 and 75,000 with peaks near 100,000 at start
values.80% Confidence Interval: widens progressively from month 80 onwards, ranging from about -50,000 to 125,000 at month 100

elements.summary: This line chart shows the monthly coal consumption for electricity generation in the US from 2016 to 2022, including original data, fitted values, forecasted values, and an 80% confidence interval that widens over time indicating increasing uncertainty in forecasts.
